instructions: Execute the scripts/list-jobs.mjs script from the project root.
Match the user's request against the discovered jobs and determine whether a single job can be selected.

DONE.condition: A single matching job logical identifier is clearly identified

PRESENT_JOBS.condition: The user did not provide a job name

NOT_FOUND.condition: The user provided a job name, but no available job matches it

AMBIGUOUS.condition: More than one discovered job matches the requested job name or the same logical identifier appears more than once

ERROR.condition: An error occurred while resolving the user's request
